in_sanskrit.name: Nihansh
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Victorious Lion
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Nihansh एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from the Sanskrit words 'ni' (victorious) and 'hansh' (lion). The name Nihansh represents a brave and powerful warrior, triumphant over all challenges and adversities.

The name Nihansh represents a brave and powerful warrior, triumphant over all challenges and adversities.
